critical_code_review_comments: studio-check-status p tag is rendered inside a scrollable column that may be below the 1080-px fold on narrower desktops — inner_text() returned '' until scrolled; inner_html is correct. Not a bug, but adding a wrapping container with a stable test id around the whole 'Checks' panel would make e2e assertions less viewport-dependent.

The dev-time wrapper spans (data-ve-dynamic, x-excluded, x-file-name=CommissionBuilds etc.) ship into the live preview DOM. They don't affect behaviour but inflate bytes and leak internal file paths; strip these in the production build.
